# L.L. Kirchner

> Official site of author L.L. Kirchner: psychological suspense (the Steel City Mysteries, set in 1990s Pittsburgh) and historical crime fiction (The Queenpin Chronicles). Signed books are sold direct.

## Books and shop
- [Shop signed books](https://llkirchner.com/shop.html): signed paperbacks, the Queenpin holiday gift bundle, and the signed e-book preorder of Now Entering the Chat (November 19)
- [All books](https://llkirchner.com/books.html): the full list of novels and memoirs
- [The Critic](https://llkirchner.com/the-critic.html): Steel City Mysteries, Book One
- [The Heiress](https://llkirchner.com/heiress.html): Steel City Mysteries, coming January 2027
- [Florida Girls](https://llkirchner.com/florida-girls.html), [Vegas Girls](https://llkirchner.com/vegas-girls.html), [Havana Girls](https://llkirchner.com/havana-girls.html): The Queenpin Chronicles
